questions.text: When you have money to spend, what should come first?
questions.explanation: First we fill the needs, then we can enjoy the wants.

questions.text: When you see a treat not on your list at the checkout, what should you do?
options: Buy it because it looks fun
Put it in the cart to share
Enjoy the smell and walk on
Ask the cashier for a discount
questions.explanation: If it's not on the list, it's a want, so we enjoy the smell and continue with our plan.

questions.text: You have four coins, a mango costs two coins and a toy car costs five coins. What can you buy?
questions.explanation: Together they cost seven coins, which is more than you have, so you can only buy the mango.

questions.text: Saving a coin for later is a good idea if you already have a sticker book.
questions.explanation: Since the sticker is a want and you already have a book, saving the coin is wise.
